name: t3-kemeny-pullmajority-v1
convention: lower score = predicted better day_b rank; scores are PREDICTED
chosen_on: design data only (snapshot days <= 2026-11-17), see evals/claude/t3-movers/notes.md
prev_weight_note: Pair by pair, earlier days never move a day_a pull share across one half: a day_a pull moves a pair's weighted margin by 0.5 or 0, an earlier pull by at most 0.5 * its weight, and prev_cap 0.9 keeps the earlier total below one pull. This does NOT mean a strict day_a majority always wins. The Kemeny order is chosen over the whole list, so when day_a's pairwise majorities form a cycle one of them loses, and earlier-day margins summed over several pairs can decide which. 0.1 rather than 0.001 so an earlier-day margin beats the 1e-3 consensus tie-break in the Kemeny objective.
over_14_items: consensus order is kept (no exact search past 14 items)
